# eCommerce Facebook Ads

Course 3 of the Ads Clinic classroom (Nick Boddington). Course page: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/85cb4679

> This module shows you how to build eCom campaigns that convert - from choosing the right objective to structuring cold, retargeting, and post-purchase ads. Learn how to write ad copy that sells, test creative, and scale what works.

**Source note:** lesson text as published in Skool, plus video transcripts cleaned from the English closed captions of Skool-hosted lesson videos (auto-generated captions: filler words and stutters removed, otherwise verbatim, so expect occasional mis-heard words). Lessons whose video is a YouTube link have no transcript. Images in lessons are omitted.

## Key metrics: ROAS, AOV, Cost per Purchase

Section: Optimising for Sales  
Source: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/85cb4679?md=21dbf18243934ca498bcf6d0ff1c52d7

*Video: lesson video hosted in Skool.*

#### Lesson text

If you don’t measure it, you can’t scale it. Learn what ROAS, AOV, and Cost per Purchase *really* tell you — and how to use them to judge performance and drive profitable growth.

High level:  
LP > ATC = 10%  
ATC > IC = 40%  
ATC > Purchase = 60 - 80%  
LP > Purchase 2-4%
